reason: A DSH plugin for persistent cross-session agent memory and knowledge management, using a semantic graph to store, recall, validate, and automatically inject relevant context.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 智能体提供跨会话记忆与知识图谱管理，支持记忆召回、验证、更新及相关上下文自动注入。
summaries.en: Provides DSH agents with cross-session memory and knowledge-graph management, including recall, validation, updates, and automatic injection of relevant context.

capabilities: Persistent cross-session memory storage and recall
Semantic graph organization of memories and concepts
Automatic injection of relevant memory into agent turns
Memory and knowledge card creation, updating, linking, verification, and removal
Local calibration service for validating recalled knowledge
